title: Bounded-above flat module complexes are K-flat
statement: Let R be a ring and let P^\bullet be a bounded-above cochain complex of flat R-modules, where flat means that tensoring with the module preserves exact sequences. Then for every acyclic cochain complex L^\bullet of R-modules, the total tensor complex Tot(L^\bullet \otimes_R P^\bullet) is acyclic; equivalently P^\bullet is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex].

proof.text: Apply the first clause of [lem-pc-kflat-closure] to the one-point site whose unique sheaf of rings is R. Sheaves of modules on this site are exactly R-modules, and complexes, tensor products, acyclicity, and K-flatness identify with the corresponding module constructions. Thus a bounded-above complex P^\bullet of flat R-modules is K-flat, which by [def-pc-kflat-complex] says that Tot(L^\bullet \otimes_R P^\bullet) is acyclic for every acyclic L^\bullet.
